description:
Find and book flights & holidays through ChatGPT. Simply tag easyJet and tell your assistant when and where you want to go, then view all the flights or holidays that match. You can even ask your assistant to track flights to see if they’re on time! Once you’ve selected a flight or holiday you can click through to the easyJet website to complete your booking.
 
Connect the easyJet app and:
- Search flights or package holidays by destination and date
- Compare flight or package holiday prices across different dates & times  
- Check the live status of your flight
- Book your flight or holiday with a link directly to the easyJet website

defaultPrompt: Find me a holiday to Tenerife for 2 adults next month
I’m looking for return flights to Amsterdam from London in January 2027
What’s the status of the flight from Gatwick to Barcelona today?
